paragraphs.text: translated by
1. BRISK, at the place of Ila, hymned by men who wake, our own familiar Friend is kindled in the house;
paragraphs.original: सं जागृवद्भिर्जरमाण इध्यते दमे दमूना इषयन्निळस्पदे ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃ jāgṛvadbhirjaramāṇa idhyate dame damūnā iṣayanniḷaspade |

paragraphs.text: Hotar of all oblation, worthy of our choice, Lord, beaming, trusty friend to one who loveth him.
paragraphs.original: विश्वस्य होता हविषो वरेण्यो विभुर्विभावा सुषखा सखीयते
paragraphs.translit: viśvasya hotā haviṣo vareṇyo vibhurvibhāvā suṣakhā sakhīyate

paragraphs.text: 2. He, excellent in glory, guest in every house, finds like a swift-winged bird a home in every tree.
paragraphs.original: स दर्शतश्रीरतिथिर्गृहेगृहे वनेवने शिश्रिये तक्ववीरिव ।
paragraphs.translit: sa darśataśrīratithirgṛhegṛhe vanevane śiśriye takvavīriva |

paragraphs.text: Benevolent to men, he scorns no living man: Friend to the tribes of men he dwells with every tribe.
paragraphs.original: जनंजनं जन्यो नाति मन्यते विश आ क्षेति विश्यो विशंविशम्
paragraphs.translit: janaṃjanaṃ janyo nāti manyate viśa ā kṣeti viśyo viśaṃviśam

paragraphs.text: 3. Most sage with insight, passing skillful with thy powers art thou, O Agni, wise with wisdom, knowing all.
paragraphs.original: सुदक्षो दक्षैः क्रतुनासि सुक्रतुरग्ने कविः काव्येनासि विश्ववित् ।
paragraphs.translit: sudakṣo dakṣaiḥ kratunāsi sukraturagne kaviḥ kāvyenāsi viśvavit |

paragraphs.text: As Vasu, thou alone art Lord of all good things, of all the treasures that the heavens and earth produce.
paragraphs.original: वसुर्वसूनां क्षयसि त्वमेक इद्द्यावा च यानि पृथिवी च पुष्यतः
paragraphs.translit: vasurvasūnāṃ kṣayasi tvameka iddyāvā ca yāni pṛthivī ca puṣyataḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Foreknowing well, O Agni, thou in Ila's place hast occupied thy regular station balmed with oil.
paragraphs.original: प्रजानन्नग्ने तव योनिमृत्वियमिळायास्पदे घृतवन्तमासदः ।
paragraphs.translit: prajānannagne tava yonimṛtviyamiḷāyāspade ghṛtavantamāsadaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Marked are thy comings like the comings of the Dawns, the rays of him who shineth spotless as the Sun.
paragraphs.original: आ ते चिकित्र उषसामिवेतयोऽरेपसः सूर्यस्येव रश्मयः
paragraphs.translit: ā te cikitra uṣasāmivetayo'repasaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Thy glories are, as lightnings from the rainy cloud, marked, many-hued, like heralds of the Dawns' approach,
paragraphs.original: तव श्रियो वर्ष्यस्येव विद्युतश्चित्राश्चिकित्र उषसां न केतवः ।
paragraphs.translit: tava śriyo varṣyasyeva vidyutaścitrāścikitra uṣasāṃ na ketavaḥ |

paragraphs.text: When, loosed to wander over plants and forest trees, thou crammest by thyself thy food into thy mouth.
paragraphs.original: यदोषधीरभिसृष्टो वनानि च परि स्वयं चिनुषे अन्नमास्ये
paragraphs.translit: yadoṣadhīrabhisṛṣṭo vanāni ca pari svayaṃ cinuṣe annamāsye

paragraphs.text: 6. Him, duly coming as their germ, have plants received: this Agni have maternal Waters brought to life.
paragraphs.original: तमोषधीर्दधिरे गर्भमृत्वियं तमापो अग्निं जनयन्त मातरः ।
paragraphs.translit: tamoṣadhīrdadhire garbhamṛtviyaṃ tamāpo agniṃ janayanta mātaraḥ |

paragraphs.text: So in like manner do the forest trees and plants bear him within them and produce him evermore.
paragraphs.original: तमित्समानं वनिनश्च वीरुधोऽन्तर्वतीश्च सुवते च विश्वहा
paragraphs.translit: tamitsamānaṃ vaninaśca vīrudho'ntarvatīśca suvate ca viśvahā

paragraphs.text: 7. When, sped and urged by wind, thou spreadest thee abroad, swift piercing through thy food according to thy will,
paragraphs.original: वातोपधूत इषितो वशाँ अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे ।
paragraphs.translit: vātopadhūta iṣito vaśām̐ anu tṛṣu yadannā veviṣadvitiṣṭhase |

paragraphs.text: Thy never-ceasing blazes, longing to consume, like men on chariots, Agni, strive on every side.
paragraphs.original: आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यो यथा पृथक्छर्धांस्यग्ने अजराणि धक्षतः
paragraphs.translit: ā te yatante rathyo yathā pṛthakchardhāṃsyagne ajarāṇi dhakṣataḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Agni, the Hotar-priest who fills the assembly full, Waker of knowledge, chief Controller of the thought,-
paragraphs.original: मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निं होतारं परिभूतमं मतिम् ।
paragraphs.translit: medhākāraṃ vidathasya prasādhanamagniṃ hotāraṃ paribhūtamaṃ matim |

paragraphs.text: Him, yea, none other than thyself, doth man elect at sacrificial offerings great and small alike.
paragraphs.original: तमिदर्भे हविष्या समानमित्तमिन्महे वृणते नान्यं त्वत्
paragraphs.translit: tamidarbhe haviṣyā samānamittaminmahe vṛṇate nānyaṃ tvat

paragraphs.text: 9. Here, Api, the arrangers, those attached to thee, elect thee as their Priest in sacred gatherings,
paragraphs.original: त्वामिदत्र वृणते त्वायवो होतारमग्ने विदथेषु वेधसः ।
paragraphs.translit: tvāmidatra vṛṇate tvāyavo hotāramagne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ |

paragraphs.text: When men with strewn clipt grass and sacrificial gifts offer thee entertainment, piously inclined.
paragraphs.original: यद्देवयन्तो दधति प्रयांसि ते हविष्मन्तो मनवो वृक्तबर्हिषः
paragraphs.translit: yaddevayanto dadhati prayāṃsi te haviṣmanto manavo vṛktabarhiṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Thine is the Herald's task and Cleanser's duly timed; Leader art thou, and Kindler for the pious man.
paragraphs.original: तवाग्ने होत्रं तव पोत्रमृत्वियं तव नेष्ट्रं त्वमग्निदृतायतः ।
paragraphs.translit: tavāgne hotraṃ tava potramṛtviyaṃ tava neṣṭraṃ tvamagnidṛtāyataḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thou art Director, thou the ministering Priest: thou art the Brahman, Lord and Master in our home.
paragraphs.original: तव प्रशास्त्रं त्वमध्वरीयसि ब्रह्मा चासि गृहपतिश्च नो दमे
paragraphs.translit: tava praśāstraṃ tvamadhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiśca no dame

paragraphs.text: 11. When mortal man presents to thee Immortal God, Agni, his fuel or his sacrificial gift,
paragraphs.original: यस्तुभ्यमग्ने अमृताय मर्त्यः समिधा दाशदुत वा हविष्कृति ।
paragraphs.translit: yastubhyamagne amṛtāya martyaḥ samidhā dāśaduta vā haviṣkṛti |

paragraphs.text: Then thou art his Adhvaryu, Hotar, messenger, callest the Gods and orderest the sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: तस्य होता भवसि यासि दूत्यमुप ब्रूषे यजस्यध्वरीयसि
paragraphs.translit: tasya hotā bhavasi yāsi dūtyamupa brūṣe yajasyadhvarīyasi

paragraphs.text: 12. From us these hymns in concert have gone forth to him, these. holy words, these Rcas, songs and eulogies,
paragraphs.original: इमा अस्मै मतयो वाचो अस्मदाँ ऋचो गिरः सुष्टुतयः समग्मत ।
paragraphs.translit: imā asmai matayo vāco asmadām̐ ṛco giraḥ suṣṭutayaḥ samagmata |

paragraphs.text: Eager for wealth, to Jatavedas fain for wealth: when they have waxen strong they please their Strengthener.
paragraphs.original: वसूयवो वसवे जातवेदसे वृद्धासु चिद्वर्धनो यासु चाकनत्
paragraphs.translit: vasūyavo vasave jātavedase vṛddhāsu cidvardhano yāsu cākanat

paragraphs.text: 13. This newest eulogy will I speak forth to him, the Ancient One who loves it. May he hear our voice.
paragraphs.original: इमां प्रत्नाय सुष्टुतिं नवीयसीं वोचेयमस्मा उशते शृणोतु नः ।
paragraphs.translit: imāṃ pratnāya suṣṭutiṃ navīyasīṃ voceyamasmā uśate śṛṇotu naḥ |

paragraphs.text: May it come near his heart and make it stir with love, as a fond well-dressed matron clings about her lord.
paragraphs.original: भूया अन्तरा हृद्यस्य निस्पृशे जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः
paragraphs.translit: bhūyā antarā hṛdyasya nispṛśe jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ

paragraphs.text: 14. He in whom horses, bulls, oxen, and barren cows, and rams, when duly set apart, are offered up,-
paragraphs.original: यस्मिन्नश्वास ऋषभास उक्षणो वशा मेषा अवसृष्टास आहुताः ।
paragraphs.translit: yasminnaśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭāsa āhutāḥ |

paragraphs.text: To Agni, Soma-sprinkled, drinker of sweet juice, Disposer, with my heart I bring a fair hymn forth.
paragraphs.original: कीलालपे सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे हृदा मतिं जनये चारुमग्नये
paragraphs.translit: kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase hṛdā matiṃ janaye cārumagnaye

paragraphs.text: 15. Into thy mouth is poured the offering, Agni, as Soma into cup, oil into ladle.
paragraphs.original: अहाव्यग्ने हविरास्ये ते स्रुचीव घृतं चम्वीव सोमः ।
paragraphs.translit: ahāvyagne havirāsye te srucīva ghṛtaṃ camvīva somaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Vouchsafe us wealth. strength-winning, blest with heroes, wealth lofty, praised by men, and full of splendour.
paragraphs.original: वाजसनिं रयिमस्मे सुवीरं प्रशस्तं धेहि यशसं बृहन्तम्
paragraphs.translit: vājasaniṃ rayimasme suvīraṃ praśastaṃ dhehi yaśasaṃ bṛhantam
